description: This source file implements functions for parsing and handling HTTP chunked transfer encoding, including initialization, reset, iteration, extraction, and cleanup operations.

methods.name: void li_chunk_parser_init(liChunkParserCtx * ctx,liChunkQueue * cq)
methods.description: Initializes the chunk parser context with a chunk queue and resets its state.

methods.name: void li_chunk_parser_reset(liChunkParserCtx * ctx)
methods.description: Resets the chunk parser context to its initial state.

methods.name: liHandlerResult li_chunk_parser_prepare(liChunkParserCtx * ctx)
methods.description: Prepares the parser for processing, ensuring the current iterator is set.

methods.name: liHandlerResult li_chunk_parser_next(liChunkParserCtx * ctx,char ** p,char ** pe,GError ** err)
methods.description: Reads the next chunk of data, updating the parser state and returning the result status.

methods.name: void li_chunk_parser_done(liChunkParserCtx * ctx,goffset len)
methods.description: Updates the parser context with the number of bytes processed.

methods.name: gboolean li_chunk_extract_to(liChunkParserMark from,liChunkParserMark to,GString * dest,GError ** err)
methods.description: Extracts data between two marks into a GString, handling memory and errors.

methods.name: GString * li_chunk_extract(liChunkParserMark from,liChunkParserMark to,GError ** err)
methods.description: Creates a new GString containing data between two marks, or returns NULL if extraction fails.
